rule_questions: Efficacy 4: the xenograft predicted activity (complete regressions) and patients responded (ORR 31%) but below the sponsor's 40% bar. Does missing a pre-specified ORR bar count as a direction contra, or only as neg/partial?

Efficacy 6: the transgenic mouse compared normal B-cell depletion depth with rituximab as monotherapy; the trial tested tumour ORR on an ICE/DHAP backbone. Is a model readout of normal-B-cell depletion a prediction of tumour-response superiority, or should this be untested (conditions/readout never tested)?

Safety 3: monkey kidney nephropathy and testis toxicity had no reported patient counterpart. Testis is unmeasurable in practice; kidney could have shown. Does a named harm absent in patients force contra/opposite, or is it absorbed into same+partial?
Can a sponsor Review (Blanc 2011) carry an untested opener's quote when it is the only public statement of the model, or must the opener cite the primary paper?
